invite.subject: Admin panel invitation
invite.body:
Hello, {name}!

You have been invited to the admin panel. To sign in, open {link}, enter this email, the code {code} and choose a password. Then set up an authenticator app.

The code is valid until {expires}; case, dashes and spaces do not matter. Lost this email? You can have it sent again on the same page. If the code has expired, ask an administrator to send a new one.

If you did not expect this invitation, just ignore this email.

access_reset.subject: Admin panel access reset
access_reset.body:
Hello, {name}!

Your admin panel access has been reset: your password, second factor and recovery codes no longer work. To sign in again, open {link}, enter this email, the code {code} and choose a new password. Then set up an authenticator app again.

The code is valid until {expires}; case, dashes and spaces do not matter. Lost this email? You can have it sent again on the same page. If the code has expired, ask an administrator to send a new one.

If you did not expect this reset, tell an admin panel owner.
